# Jan Härkönen

> Senior Full Stack Developer in Helsinki, Finland. Web apps and AI. Core stack: React, Go, Python, Convex, Postgres, Linux.

Personal portfolio at https://janharkonen.fi. Focus areas include real-time UIs, typesafety, performance, and DX.

## Projects

- [cdx](https://janharkonen.fi/cdx): Bash CLI tool to cd into directories 10x faster
- [ÉclairDB](https://janharkonen.fi/eclairdb): Lightning-fast PostgreSQL database exploration with intuitive search and filtering capabilities
- [HSL real time](https://janharkonen.fi/hsl-real-time): Real-time vehicle locations for Helsinki public transport.
- [Lens and mirror simulator](https://janharkonen.fi/lens-mirror-simulator): Desktop GUI for simulating the trajectory of a laser beam through curved lenses and mirrors
- [Offer generator](https://janharkonen.fi/offer-generator): Product data synchronization and sales processes automation tool as a web app aimed at small businesses
- [Portfolio site](https://janharkonen.fi/portfolio-site): This very website. A personal full stack developer portfolio
- [Progress tracker](https://janharkonen.fi/progress-tracker): Web application to track the progress level of listed items for each user in real time using websockets
- [Secure receipt share](https://janharkonen.fi/secure-receipt-share): Secure way to share receipts with colleagues.
- [Speed reader](https://janharkonen.fi/speed-reader): A lightweight .epub ebook reader with RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) capability.
- [SyncSpace](https://janharkonen.fi/syncspace): Simple list+checkbox based tool for collaborative task management with real-time synchronization
- [Trip planner](https://janharkonen.fi/trip-planner): Website for travel details of a 3-day trip for 60 people. Time-table, relevant links and FAQ.
- [TUI portfolio](https://janharkonen.fi/tui-portfolio): Terminal twin of this portfolio site (ssh terminal.janharkonen.fi).
- [Wedding site](https://janharkonen.fi/wedding-site): Wedding site to inform guests about the wedding details. Includes schedule, sign-up, and other information as well as a photo album
